data.name: GLOAM
data.detailed_description:
GLOAM is an immersive, first-person, role-playing platform set in an alternate universe in which dark powers have triumphed over humanity. More than just a single game, GLOAM is a living ecosystem in which multiple experiences (including single-player, multi-player, survival and sandbox modes) coexist within the same universe. These experiences share mechanics, progression and lore while offering entirely different ways to experience the world.

Each experience is released as a dedicated DLC built on the same core platform. Rather than being standalone games, these expansions form a unified entity that can evolve continuously alongside the community. This allows creators and players alike to expand the GLOAM universe with new stories, worlds, and mechanics,

Whether you are seeking a narrative-driven adventure, cooperative survival, competitive multiplayer encounters or unrestricted creativity through sandbox gameplay, all modes belong to the same interconnected realm. This ensures consistent gameplay systems, seamless progression and a shared narrative that grows over time.

Gameplay and core features:

  • Unified Platform: a single, interconnected ecosystem in which story, multiplayer, survival and sandbox experiences coexist as individual free DLCs. These share the same gameplay foundations, progression systems, mechanics, and lore, while offering distinct gameplay styles tailored to different types of players.

  • Designed as a Platform rather than a standalone title, GLOAM is built to grow over time through official expansions and community-created content. This enables new scenarios, mechanics and game modes to become part of the same evolving universe.

  • Deep First-Person Immersion: atmospheric exploration blends seamlessly with tense, responsive combat, placing players directly inside every encounter and discovery.

  • Meaningful Environmental Interaction: manipulate physical objects, decipher layered puzzles and reconstruct the world's mysteries through careful observation and exploration.

  • Branching Narrative: a non-linear story that reacts to player choices, exploration and actions, leading to multiple outcomes and encouraging replayability through significantly different paths.

  • Consequential Moral Decisions: Ethical choices influence the narrative, the protagonist's psychological state, and the unfolding of events.

  • Advanced Stealth & Dynamic Environments: Exploit darkness, sound, timing, verticality and environmental interactions to outsmart enemies through adaptable stealth systems and reactive level design.

  • Persistent Shared Lore: every game mode contributes to the same overarching universe, enabling players to experience different perspectives of the same world without compromising narrative consistency or gameplay cohesion.

data.short_description: GLOAM is a first-person immersive RPG platform set in a uchronian dystopian world where dark powers have triumphed over humanity. Story, Multiplayer, Survival, and Sandbox coexist in one evolving ecosystem, sharing mechanics, systems, and lore. Will you succumb... or embrace the Gloaming?
